0022600175.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-5, with two straight losses) visit the Boston Celtics (5-1, on a five-game winning streak) as they sit 14th in the East and 5th in the Central, four games back. Boston has been strong at home at 4-0 and is second in the Atlantic, while Devin Carter (illness) and Paul George (rest) are both out. The teams have not met yet this season, and Boston won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 133-101 win in Milwaukee on April 3, 2026.
